item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang gcod yid bzhin nor bu'i phyag bzhes gsal byed sgron ma
item.coloph: de ltar gsang gcod yid bzhin nor bu'i phyag bzhes gsal byed mun sel sgron me zhes bya ba/ lha grogs dam pa'i bka' yis rab bskul ngor/ gshen gyi brgyud 'dzin mkhan slob zung gi bka' gnang thob pa dang / bla ma gong ma'i phyag len dang zhal rgyun la brten nas/ ra btsun rgyal ba ming gis dar lding dben khrod du bkod pa'i/ lag len spus tshang du 'dug ste gshen lugs khro bo yul 'dir dkon stabs/ sngon 'gro'i skor mi snyed kyang blo dman mgo 'khor gyi dwogs nas bru lugs ltar cung zad bsgyur bcos byas pa po ni rtse zhig slob bu'i ming 'dzin rtse dbus chos rjes kyis bkod pa'i 'gal 'khrul thams cad ma dang mkha'-i 'gror bshags/ dge ba'i gdams pa phyogs dus kun tu 'phel bar shog/
